verdict.rationale: Clerky documents a REST Partner API (document sets, forms, lifecycle polling) and a remote MCP server, but nothing in the evidence mentions an official client SDK in any language. A raw HTTP API and an MCP endpoint are adjacent capabilities, not SDKs, and its OAuth access is still listed as 'coming soon'. SDKs are a fair question for an API-bearing SaaS product, so this is 'none' rather than 'na'.
